name: file-prompts
description: Suggested requests for a file, offered in its Ask AI panel and in a room whose workbench shows it: decks, documents, sheets, PDFs, Markdown, tables and images.

prompts.title: Tighten the wording
prompts.body: Tighten the wording on every slide: shorter titles, fewer words per bullet, the same meaning. Keep the layout and design.

prompts.title: Add speaker notes
prompts.body: Write speaker notes for each slide that has none: two to four sentences on what to say.

prompts.title: Make it consistent
prompts.body: Check the deck for inconsistent fonts, sizes, colours, alignment and capitalisation, and fix them.

prompts.title: Summarize the deck
prompts.body: Summarize this deck in five bullet points. Do not change the file.

prompts.title: Proofread
prompts.body: Proofread the document: fix spelling, grammar and punctuation without changing the meaning or the formatting.

prompts.title: Make it concise
prompts.body: Make the document more concise: cut repetition and filler, keep every point and the formatting.

prompts.title: Improve the structure
prompts.body: Improve the structure: clear headings, a logical order, one idea per paragraph. Keep the content.

prompts.title: Summarize
prompts.body: Summarize this document in five bullet points. Do not change the file.

prompts.title: Explain this workbook
prompts.body: Explain what this workbook contains and how its sheets relate. Do not change the file.

prompts.title: Check the formulas
prompts.body: Check the formulas and totals for errors or inconsistencies, fix them, and list what you changed.

prompts.title: Tidy the formatting
prompts.body: Make number formats, column widths and header styles consistent across the sheets. Keep every value.

prompts.title: Add a summary
prompts.body: Add a summary of the key figures (totals, averages, changes) where it fits best, using formulas.

prompts.title: Summarize
prompts.body: Summarize this PDF: the key points, the decisions and the open questions, on one page. Do not change the file.

prompts.title: Pull out the key figures
prompts.body: List the key figures and dates in this PDF as a table, each with the page it comes from.

prompts.title: Questions to ask
prompts.body: List the questions a careful reader should ask after reading this PDF, with the passage that raises each.

prompts.title: Proofread
prompts.body: Proofread this document: fix spelling, grammar and punctuation, keep the meaning and the Markdown.

prompts.title: Make it concise
prompts.body: Make this document more concise: cut repetition and filler, keep every point and the headings.

prompts.title: Turn it into slides
prompts.body: Turn this document into a short slide deck (.pptx), one idea per slide, with speaker notes.

prompts.title: Explain this table
prompts.body: Explain what this table holds: its columns, its rows and anything unusual. Do not change the file.

prompts.title: Find anomalies
prompts.body: Find missing values, duplicates and outliers in this table and list them by row.

prompts.title: Chart it
prompts.body: Make a chart of the most telling numbers in this table, as an image I can preview here.

prompts.title: Describe it
prompts.body: Describe this image: what it shows, its text, and anything notable. Do not change the file.

prompts.title: Make variations
prompts.body: Make two variations of this image with the same subject and a different style.
